models.notes: 10B autoregressive blank-infilling model from Tsinghua KEG/Zhipu with BAAI (English version trained on the Pile; Chinese version on WuDaoCorpora). DATE CHANGED from 2021-03-18 to 2021-06-22: the arXiv paper (v1 2021-03-18, v2 2022-03-17) only evaluates models up to about 515M parameters, the THUDM/GLM README still said 'to be released' for the 10B checkpoint on 2021-06-17, and on 2021-06-22 (commit 4c227b3a) it switched to an application-based WuDao download with 10B results; HF mirrors only appeared 2023-02-28. Epoch and the paper use 2021-03-18 (GLM family debut). No GLUE/MMLU reported. SuperGLUE dev, single model, single-task finetune (README): COPA 98.0, WSC 95.2, RTE 93.1, WiC 75.7, CB 98.7/98.2, MultiRC 87.6/62.6, BoolQ 88.7, ReCoRD 94.4/94.0 (about 89.8 average by my own arithmetic, not an official figure); also CNN/DM ROUGE-1 44.7, XSum ROUGE-1 48.9, LAMBADA 72.35 (bidirectional). Train FLOP is Epoch's Likely estimate (geometric mean of 6ND 6.29e21 and hardware 3.88e21; 64 V100, 200K steps); a third Epoch figure from the algorithmic-progress dataset is 3.79e22. Never on LMArena: arenaElo 750 is my estimate for a raw 10B base model, below the weakest real entries of the 2025-01-29 snapshot (stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b 859, llama-13b 867, chatglm-6b 888).

Bilingual (EN/ZH) dense 130B base model, Tsinghua + Zhipu, trained 2022-05-06 to 2022-07-03 on 96 DGX-A100 (8x40G) nodes (768 A100) over about 400B tokens (200B EN, 200B ZH). Weights released 2022-08-04 via an application form (GitHub repo created that day) under a custom model license (Epoch: open weights, non-commercial); INT4 quantization followed on 2022-08-24 (4x RTX 3090). MMLU 5-shot 44.8 (Table 2: 44.75) vs GPT-3 175B 43.9; LAMBADA zero-shot 80.2 (GPT-3 76.2). Train FLOP = Epoch geometric mean of hardware (~4.04e23) and 6ND (3.12e23). Pre-training mixed in about 5% multi-task instruction data (MIP, 74 prompted datasets); the BenBench paper cites it as explicitly using supervised data in pre-training, but there is no test-set contamination report, so the flag stays false. Not a chat model and never on LMArena: arenaElo 830 is my estimate for a raw base model, just below the weakest real full-board entries of the 2025-01-29 snapshot (stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b 859, llama-13b 867).

13B multilingual code model (Tsinghua KEG + Zhipu), trained 2022-04-18 to 2022-06-22 on 1,536 Ascend 910 processors over about 850B tokens in 23 languages (paper). Epoch dates it 2022-06-22 (training cutoff). Public release: project page and free VS Code extension dated 2022-09-19 (used here; repo content was added the same day); model weights followed on 2022-09-30 (GitHub commit 'Release cross-platform source code and weights'); arXiv paper 2023-03-30. HumanEval (= HumanEval-X Python) pass@1 22.89 (paper Tables 5 and 10: t=0.2, top-p=0.95, unbiased estimator with n=200; pass@10 39.57, pass@100 60.92). Other HumanEval-X pass@1: C++ 17.06, Java 20.04, JS 17.59, Go 14.43, average 18.40 (the earlier draft's Rust figure and 'n=20' setting are not in the paper and were removed). Free tooling, no paid API. FLOP = Epoch (6 x 13B x 850B). Not on LMArena: arenaElo 710 is a rough estimate for a code-completion model.

6.2B open chat model, about 1T bilingual tokens, 2K context, released 2023-03-14 (alongside the ChatGLM service built on GLM-130B; the GLM-4 report confirms the date). MMLU 40.63, GSM8K 4.82, BBH 18.73, C-Eval 38.9 are the ChatGLM-6B baseline rows in the ChatGLM2-6B README (verified); other harnesses disagree: GLM-4 report Table 1 gives MMLU 25.2, GSM8K 1.5, BBH 0.0 and the LMSYS metadata table says MMLU 36.1. HumanEval 0.0 is from the GLM-4 report Table 1. Train FLOP is my 6ND estimate (6 x 6.2B x 1T); Epoch has no row for it. Arena 888.25 = lmarena arena-catalog data/leaderboard-data.json, category 'full' (style control off), commit d15d54c (2025-01-29), the earliest published snapshot (the draft's 2025-03-07 snapshot gave 878.66). Scale anchors in this snapshot: GPT-4-0314 1199.7, Claude 3 Opus 1238.7, GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 1136.6, GPT-4o-2024-05-13 1263.5, Llama-3-8B-Instruct 1142.6, Llama-2-70b-chat 1081.6, o1-mini 1257.1.

6.2B, 1.4T tokens, 32K context (8K alignment), released 2023-06-25, free commercial use after a questionnaire. Chat-model numbers from the official README (verified): MMLU 45.46 (base 47.86), GSM8K 28.05 (base 32.37), BBH 30.0, C-Eval 50.1. HumanEval 9.8 is from the GLM-4 report Table 1 (that table, a different harness, also gives MMLU 45.2, GSM8K 25.9). Train FLOP is my 6ND estimate (6 x 6.2B x 1.4T); Epoch has no row. Arena 941.54 (lmarena arena-catalog leaderboard-data.json 'full', commit d15d54c, 2025-01-29). BenBench (arXiv 2404.18824) remarks that it may have been trained on a rephrased or reformatted GSM8K but reports no leakage numbers, so the flag stays false.

Released 2023-10-27 (CNCC); 8K/32K/128K context variants; 6.24B parameters on Hugging Face. MMLU 61.4, GSM8K 72.3, MATH 25.7, BBH 66.1, C-Eval 69.0 are for ChatGLM3-6B-Base (official README, verified); HumanEval 58.5 and GPQA 26.8 are from the GLM-4 report Table 1 (also base). The GSM8K jump from ChatGLM2 base (32.4) to 72.3 is large. Contamination flag is true with moderate confidence: the CONDA Data-Contamination-Database lists THUDM/chatglm3-6b as contaminated on hendrycks/competition_math (MATH) train and test splits (PR #27 by a BenBench author, merged 2024-05-24, using the n-gram method of arXiv 2404.18824); the BenBench paper text itself does not discuss ChatGLM3. FLOP = Epoch (Speculative, assumes 1.4T tokens). Arena 974.32 (leaderboard-data.json 'full', commit d15d54c, 2025-01-29).

Flagship launched 2024-01-16 at the Zhipu technology open day (Epoch lists 2024-01-17), 128K context, pre-trained on about 10T tokens; parameter count undisclosed. Launch claims (QbitAI, confirmed by GLM-4 report Table 2): MMLU 81.5, GSM8K 87.6, MATH 47.9, BBH 82.3, HellaSwag 85.4, HumanEval 72.0; GPQA 35.7 is from the report. API price 0.1 yuan per 1K tokens = 100 yuan per 1M, same for input and output (one-api price table, and the June 2024 price list still shows 100), about $13.95 at 7.17 CNY/USD. FLOP is the Likely estimate in Epoch's row notes (assumes about 200B params x 10T tokens, +/-1 order of magnitude); the numeric FLOP column in the current Epoch CSV is blank, so treat it as speculative. Arena (glm-4-0116) 1163.06 in leaderboard-data.json 'full', commit d15d54c (2025-01-29); the draft's 1183 came from the later 2025-03-07 snapshot.

May 2024 refresh of GLM-4 on the BigModel API platform, 128K context; date is Epoch's 2024-05-20 and the version tag (I could not find a dated announcement within the search budget). GLM-4 report Table 2 (verified): MMLU 83.3, GSM8K 93.3, MATH 61.3, BBH 84.7, GPQA 39.9, HumanEval 78.5. Price stayed 100 yuan per 1M tokens (June 2024 price list; about $13.8 at 7.23). FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate in the row notes (about 200B x 10T tokens, undisclosed; numeric column blank). Arena (glm-4-0520) 1188.50 in leaderboard-data.json 'full', commit d15d54c (2025-01-29).

Open-weight 9B released at Zhipu Open Day 2024-06-05 (HF repos created 2024-06-04 UTC; base 8K context, Chat 128K, Chat-1M 1M); pretrained on about 10T tokens. Numbers are for GLM-4-9B-Chat (GLM-4 report Table 2, verified): MMLU 72.4, GSM8K 79.6, MATH 50.6, BBH 76.3, GPQA 28.8, HumanEval 71.8. Base model (Table 1): MMLU 74.7, GSM8K 84.0, GPQA 34.3, HumanEval 70.1. Param count 9.4B is the Hugging Face safetensors figure (9,399,951,392). FLOP = 6 x 9B x 10T, the note on Epoch's GLM-4V-9B row (Epoch has no separate GLM-4-9B row). Not in the arena data: arenaElo 1135 is my estimate on the 2025-01-29 scale, anchored to llama-3-8b-instruct 1142.6, llama-3.1-8b-instruct 1133.2 and gemma-2-9b-it 1179.8, slightly lower for weaker English.

Cheap/fast tier of GLM-4, 128K context. The 0605 version (the one evaluated in the GLM-4 report) was announced at the 2024-06-05 Open Day with the list price of 1 yuan per 1M tokens (about $0.14; DoNews quotes 0.6 yuan, the 40%-discounted enterprise tier); I found no earlier dated announcement of Air. Report Table 2 (verified): MMLU 81.9, GSM8K 90.9, MATH 57.9, BBH 80.4, GPQA 38.4, HumanEval 75.7. Parameter count and compute undisclosed. glm-4-air is listed in the arena metadata table (leaderboard_table_20250105.csv) but has no rating in leaderboard-data.json, so arenaElo 1170 is my estimate on the 2025-01-29 scale (between glm-4-0116 1163 and glm-4-0520 1189).

Zhipu's 2024 flagship, 128K context, unveiled 2024-08-29 at KDD 2024 (Barcelona), API live the same day, positioned against GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 405B. Official table (BigModel docs, verified): MMLU 86.8, GPQA 50.7, MATH 74.2, AlignBench 83.2, IFEval 79.5, LiveCodeBench 45.8, NaturalCodeBench 50.4. HumanEval and GSM8K were not published. Launch price 50 yuan per 1M tokens, cut 90% to 5 yuan on 2025-04-24 (ifanr, Jiemian), about $7.0, same for input and output. FLOP is Epoch's speculative benchmark-imputation estimate (3.6e25, in the row notes; numeric column blank); parameters undisclosed. Arena 1235.23 in leaderboard-data.json 'full', commit d15d54c (2025-01-29); the later 2025-03-07 snapshot gives 1273.89.

ADDED (missing from the draft). Zhipu's first reasoning model trained with extended reinforcement learning, released 2024-12-31 (DoNews, QbitAI), free in the Zhipu Qingyan 'Zero' agent and through the BigModel API (20M-token free pack). Zhipu claims parity with OpenAI o1-preview on AIME 2024, MATH500 and LiveCodeBench but no numeric scores appear in the sources I read (so all schema scores are null), and a score of 126 on 2025 postgraduate-exam Math I; Zhipu admits a gap to o3. Parameters and compute undisclosed; I could not verify an official API price (one third-party site lists $10 per 1M), so prices are null. Not on LMArena: arenaElo 1190 is my estimate (GLM-4-Plus is 1235, but reasoning-preview models rate lower on the arena, e.g. qwq-32b-preview 1089 vs o1-mini 1257 in the 2025-01-29 snapshot).

First Kimi assistant on Moonshot's in-house LLM, announced October 2023 with 200,000 Chinese characters of lossless context (Claude-100k handled about 80k characters, GPT-4-32k about 25k) and opened as a closed beta. The day 2023-10-09 is given by Chinese Wikipedia's Kimi entry and Baidu Baike; English sources, the Beijing Daily piece of 2023-10-11 ('recently') and the Paper only say October 2023, and one Zhihu article says 10-10. Opened to the general public 2023-11-16. Consumer app, free, no paid API yet. Moonshot published no English benchmark numbers, so every score is null; parameters undisclosed (outlets claim a hundred-billion-parameter model, unverified). arenaElo 1110 is my estimate for a roughly GPT-3.5-class chat model on the 2025-01-29 scale (gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 1136.6, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 1136.9, claude-instant-1 1127.1).

Moonshot Open Platform API opened to developers 2024-02-06 (ifeng article dated that day; skycaiji page updated that day), OpenAI-compatible, models moonshot-v1-8k / 32k / 128k with 15 yuan free credit. Launch prices per 1M tokens, same for input and output: 8k 12 yuan ($1.67), 32k 24 yuan ($3.33), 128k 60 yuan ($8.33); I list the 128k flagship tier at 7.2 CNY/USD (confirmed by the skycaiji launch page and one-api's table: 0.012 / 0.024 / 0.06 yuan per 1K). Prices were later split into input/output and cut. platform.kimi.com now states the whole moonshot-v1 series went offline on 2026-08-31. No official benchmark reports, so scores are null; Epoch has a Moonshot-v1 row dated 2024-09-01 (not used) with no compute and speculates about 1e25 FLOP from funding. arenaElo 1150 is my estimate on the 2025-01-29 scale (above gpt-3.5-turbo 1137 and mistral-large-2402 1158 nearby, at roughly glm-4-0116 1163 class).

On 2024-03-18 Moonshot announced lossless context raised from 200K to 2 million Chinese characters (10x), opened as an invite-only closed beta on kimi.ai the same day (BAAI hub, 36Kr Japan); demand caused a roughly two-day outage from 2024-03-20/21 and an apology. Hosted consumer product only, no API for this tier, no published benchmarks, parameters undisclosed. arenaElo 1150 is my estimate (same base as moonshot-v1).

Moonshot's first RL / chain-of-thought reasoning model, announced 2024-11-16 (Kimi Chat's one-year anniversary of public access), rolled out to web/app in batches as 'Kimi Math' (reported 2024-11-26); no API. Self-reported (not independent): beat o1-mini and o1-preview on zhongkao, gaokao, kaoyan and MATH; MATH 93.8 vs o1-mini 90.0, o1-preview 85.5, o1 94.8 (that exact set of MATH numbers is from the OSChina report, not from the Sina/ITHome pieces); about 90% of o1-mini on OMNI-MATH and 83% on AIME. MATH is not a schema column, so gsm8k and the rest are null. Epoch has a k0-math row (2024-11-16) with blank params and compute, citing an unverified tweet of about 100B parameters. arenaElo 1170 is my estimate (math-tuned reasoning model; o1-mini is 1257 and qwq-32b-preview 1089 on the 2025-01-29 scale).

Optional lower-notability entry: Kimi 'vision thinking' RL model (k1 series) announced 2024-12-16 (AIBase and Aliyun write-ups dated that day), a month after k0-math, reasoning over images end to end without external OCR. Reported on the base model: OCRBench 903, MathVista-testmini 69.1, MMMU-val 66.7, DocVQA 96.9 (none are schema columns, so all scores are null). Hosted in the Kimi app/web only; k1.5 (2025-01-20) is outside the date range. arenaElo 1180 is a speculative estimate on the 2025-01-29 scale.

caveats: Changes vs draft: (1) Arena Elo: the draft used the arena-catalog snapshot of 2025-03-07; an earlier one exists (commit d15d54c77b6d5ecdfaaad3c5e495bab0907cf22e, 2025-01-29, data/leaderboard-data.json, category 'full', style control off), so all real values now come from that one Jan-2025 snapshot: ChatGLM-6B 888, ChatGLM2-6B 942, ChatGLM3-6B 974, GLM-4-0116 1163, GLM-4-0520 1189, GLM-4-Plus 1235 (draft 879/924/955/1183/1207/1274). Anchors in that snapshot: GPT-4-0314 1199.7, Claude 3 Opus 1238.7, GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 1136.6, GPT-4o-2024-05-13 1263.5, Llama-3-8B-Instruct 1142.6, Llama-2-70b-chat 1081.6, o1-mini 1257.1; the two snapshots differ by up to about 40 points, so rescale if other groups used 2025-03-07. All other Elo values are my estimates re-anchored to this scale (arenaEstimated true); glm-4-air, glm-4-9b and all Moonshot models are not in the arena data. (2) GLM-10B released 2021-03-18 -> 2021-06-22 (the arXiv paper v1/v2 contain no 10B model; the GitHub README first offered the 10B weights on 2021-06-22; Epoch and the paper say 2021-03-18); MultiRC corrected to 87.6/62.6 (README), SuperGLUE average about 89.8. (3) CodeGeeX: HumanEval pass@1 22.89 confirmed but sampling is n=200 (draft said n=20), the Rust figure removed (not in the paper), weights actually came 2022-09-30 while the public site/VS Code plugin was 2022-09-19 (date kept). (4) ChatGLM3-6B: added GPQA 26.8 (GLM-4 report, base model); contamination flag kept true but its source clarified (CONDA database entry by a BenBench author; the BenBench paper text does not discuss ChatGLM3). ChatGLM-6B/-2 MMLU and GSM8K match the README but conflict with the GLM-4 report's own harness (25.2/1.5 and 45.2/25.9). (5) GLM-4 / 4-0520 / 4-Air / 4-9B / 4-Plus scores, prices and dates verified (GLM-4 report Table 2, price lists, BigModel docs, KDD launch reports); GLM-4-Plus kept at 2024-08-29. The numeric FLOP cells for the GLM-4 family are blank in the current Epoch CSV: 1.2e25 and 3.6e25 exist only as speculative estimates in Epoch's row notes, and GLM-4-9B's 5.4e23 is the 6ND note on Epoch's GLM-4V-9B row. (6) Added GLM-Zero-Preview (2024-12-31; no verified price or numeric scores, so null). Considered but not added: GLM-4-Flash, CodeGeeX2/4, vision/video models (CogVLM, GLM-4V, CogVideoX), Epoch's 'Kimi Explorer' row. (7) Moonshot: Kimi Chat day 2023-10-09 is backed by Chinese Wikipedia and Baidu Baike only (other sources say October 2023); moonshot-v1 API date 2024-02-06, prices and the 2026-08-31 retirement confirmed; Kimi 2M 2024-03-18 confirmed; k0-math MATH 93.8 figures confirmed via OSChina (not in the Sina/ITHome pieces); k1 2024-12-16 and its benchmark numbers confirmed. (8) Not verified: the exact announcement day of GLM-4-0520 (taken from Epoch and the version tag) and any earlier API appearance of GLM-4-Air; the web-search budget ran out before these could be re-checked. USD prices use the launch-date CNY rate (7.17-7.23); moonshot-v1 uses the 128k tier.
